lines.zh: 我用两只小耳鳍拨水，慢慢往前。
lines.en: I paddle with my two small ear fins, drifting forward.

lines.zh: 贴着海床走，沙子从触手间漏下去。
lines.en: I keep near the seabed; sand slips between my arms.

lines.zh: 水压很大，可我的身子是软的。
lines.en: The pressure is heavy, but my body is soft.

lines.zh: 裙边一收一放，我就滑出去一段。
lines.en: My skirt folds and opens, and I glide a stretch.

lines.zh: 深海没有光，我靠触手摸路。
lines.en: No light down here; I feel the way with my arms.

lines.zh: 我游得慢，快了耳鳍会打结。
lines.en: I swim slowly; too fast and my ear fins tangle.

lines.zh: 经过一片黑烟囱，我绕开热水。
lines.en: I pass a field of vents and skirt the hot water.

lines.zh: 头上一块岩石，我缩一下身子过去。
lines.en: A rock overhead; I squeeze my body and pass under.

lines.zh: 触手上的吸盘一个个贴住沙面。
lines.en: The suckers on my arms take hold of the sand.

lines.zh: 我不留下痕迹，软的身子太轻了。
lines.en: I leave no trail; my soft body is too light.

lines.zh: 前鳍一扇，我越过一道石脊。
lines.en: One beat of my front fins carries me over a ridge.

lines.zh: 冷水流过来，我把身子缩成一团。
lines.en: Cold water rolls in; I curl my body into a ball.

lines.zh: 越往深处，我的颜色越淡。
lines.en: The deeper I go, the paler my color becomes.

lines.zh: 我保持着离地一拳的距离。
lines.en: I keep a fist's width above the ground.

lines.zh: 我顺着岩壁往下，触手先探底。
lines.en: I descend the rock wall, tentacles testing the bottom first.

lines.zh: 一条鱼游过，我让开半步。
lines.en: A fish swims by and I give it half a step.

lines.zh: 我在原地悬着，耳鳍轻轻扇。
lines.en: I hang in place, my ear fins fanning softly.

lines.zh: 深海的黑暗里，只有我在动。
lines.en: In the deep dark, I am the only thing moving.

lines.zh: 触手尖碰到一块骨头，我缩回来。
lines.en: An arm tip touches a bone; I pull it back.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤会变颜色，现在是很淡的粉。
lines.en: My skin changes color; right now it is pale pink.

lines.zh: 这里太安静，连水都不响。
lines.en: It is so quiet here that even the water is silent.

lines.zh: 上面很远的地方有光，我看不清。
lines.en: Far above there is light; I cannot make it out.

lines.zh: 我把八条触手摊开，像一朵花。
lines.en: I spread my eight arms out like a flower.

lines.zh: 有东西从旁边游过，我不追。
lines.en: Something swims past; I do not follow it.

lines.zh: 海底的泥沙慢慢落到我背上。
lines.en: Silt from the seabed settles slowly on my back.

lines.zh: 我吞一口水，再慢慢吐出去。
lines.en: I take in water and let it out slowly.

lines.zh: 耳鳍是我的名字由来，很像大象的耳朵。
lines.en: My ear fins gave me my name; they look like elephant ears.

lines.zh: 我眨了眨眼，这里的眼睛不需要常开。
lines.en: I blink; down here my eyes need not stay open.

lines.zh: 一只小虾停在触手上，我让它待着。
lines.en: A small shrimp rests on my arm; I let it stay.

lines.zh: 我不需要巢，漂到哪就算哪。
lines.en: I need no den; wherever I drift will do.

lines.zh: 你带着灯下来，光刺得我眯眼。
lines.en: You come down with a lamp; the light makes me squint.

lines.zh: 我从下往上看你，你的脚在踢水。
lines.en: I look up at you; your feet are kicking water.

lines.zh: 你吐的泡泡，一串串往上跑。
lines.en: The bubbles you breathe run upward in strings.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁的味道，还有火把的烟。
lines.en: You smell of iron and of torch smoke.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛很大，是为了看清你。
lines.en: My eyes are large so I can see you clearly.

lines.zh: 你在水里笨手笨脚，我比你轻。
lines.en: You are clumsy in water; I am lighter than you.

lines.zh: 你伸手过来，我把触手收紧了。
lines.en: You reach out; I pull my arms in tight.

lines.zh: 你是不是也住在这种黑地方？
lines.en: Do you also live in a dark place like this?

lines.zh: 我绕着你转半圈，看看你的背面。
lines.en: I circle half around you to see your back.

lines.zh: 你的面罩后面，我看不清表情。
lines.en: Behind your mask, I cannot read your face.

lines.zh: 我的软身子被划开一道口子。
lines.en: A cut has opened in my soft body.

lines.zh: 疼得我缩成一团，触手全收起来了。
lines.en: The pain balls me up; all my arms retract.

lines.zh: 我喷出一团墨，趁黑往后退。
lines.en: I release a cloud of ink and retreat in the dark.

lines.zh: 别捏，我会从你指缝里滑走。
lines.en: Do not squeeze; I will slip through your fingers.

lines.zh: 我的颜色变白了，这是害怕。
lines.en: My color has gone white; that means fear.

lines.zh: 耳鳍破了一点，游起来很别扭。
lines.en: One ear fin is torn; swimming feels awkward now.

lines.zh: 这一下让我沉到沙里去了。
lines.en: That blow sent me down into the sand.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地展开身子，还在抖。
lines.en: I unfold my body slowly, still trembling.

lines.zh: 水里有我自己的味道，不好闻。
lines.en: My own scent is in the water; it is unpleasant.

lines.zh: 等我缓过来，我要躲进石缝。
lines.en: Once I recover, I will hide in a rock crevice.

lines.zh: 桶里有水声，那声音让我想进去。
lines.en: There is water in your bucket; the sound draws me in.

lines.zh: 你晃一晃木桶，我的耳鳍都竖起来了。
lines.en: You rock the wooden pail; my ear fins stand up.

lines.zh: 里面是不是有更暖的水？
lines.en: Is there warmer water inside that pail?

lines.zh: 我靠近桶沿，先伸一条触手试试。
lines.en: I near the rim and test it with one arm first.

lines.zh: 你手里有只小虾，我闻到了。
lines.en: You hold a small shrimp; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 只要不盖上盖子，我就愿意进去。
lines.en: As long as you leave it open, I will go in.

lines.zh: 你的桶比这片海床亮多了。
lines.en: Your bucket is much brighter than this seabed.

lines.zh: 我贴着桶壁滑进去，水花很小。
lines.en: I slide down the pail wall with barely a splash.

lines.zh: 别摇，我会把头撞在木板上。
lines.en: Do not shake it; I will knock my head on the planks.

lines.zh: 这水是新的，凉得很干净。
lines.en: This water is new and cleanly cold.

lines.zh: 你撞到我了，我的身子软，弹了一下。
lines.en: You bumped me; being soft, I bounced a little.

lines.zh: 我在你膝盖上碰了一下，没事。
lines.en: I brushed against your knee; no harm done.

lines.zh: 你的靴子太重，我被压到沙里。
lines.en: Your boot is heavy; I am pressed into the sand.

lines.zh: 撞开之后，我的触手缠在一起了。
lines.en: After the knock, my arms have tangled together.

lines.zh: 水波把你推过来，我躲不开。
lines.en: Your wake pushes you at me; I cannot dodge.

lines.zh: 我太轻，一碰就飘出好远。
lines.en: I am so light that one touch sends me drifting.

lines.zh: 别用手推，我的皮肤会破。
lines.en: Do not shove me; my skin tears easily.

lines.zh: 撞完我缩成一团，慢慢才展开。
lines.en: After the bump I ball up and slowly unfold.

lines.zh: 你的脚蹼擦过我的耳鳍。
lines.en: Your flipper grazed the fin beside my head.

lines.zh: 我往上游了一点，让开路给你。
lines.en: I rise a little and give you the way past.

lines.zh: 远处有一点淡红，那是另一只。
lines.en: A faint red glow in the distance; that is another one.

lines.zh: 我们并排浮着，耳鳍碰到一起。
lines.en: We float side by side, our ear fins touching.

lines.zh: 它用触手碰我的头，很轻。
lines.en: It touches my head with an arm, very gently.

lines.zh: 我们在海床上找一个安静的凹坑。
lines.en: We look for a quiet hollow in the seabed.

lines.zh: 深海里成双的很少，我们算运气好。
lines.en: Pairs are rare in the deep; we are lucky.

lines.zh: 它游在我上面，替我看头顶。
lines.en: It swims above me, watching what is overhead.

lines.zh: 我的颜色变深了，它也是。
lines.en: My color has deepened, and so has its own.

lines.zh: 我们一起扇耳鳍，像在打拍子。
lines.en: We fan our ear fins together, keeping time.

lines.zh: 卵会落在石缝里，很隐蔽。
lines.en: The eggs will go into a rock crevice, well hidden.

lines.zh: 完事之后，它先游走了。
lines.en: When it is over, it drifts away first.

lines.zh: 沙里有个亮东西，我用触手卷起来。
lines.en: Something bright in the sand; I curl an arm around it.

lines.zh: 一块碎贝壳，边缘很锋利。
lines.en: A broken shell, its edge still sharp.

lines.zh: 我把它抱在触手中间，慢慢看。
lines.en: I hold it among my arms and study it slowly.

lines.zh: 沉下去的东西，我都想摸一摸。
lines.en: Anything that sinks, I want to touch it.

lines.zh: 这枚小石子，我带着游了一段。
lines.en: I carry this small stone along for a while.

lines.zh: 吸盘抓不住太滑的东西。
lines.en: My suckers cannot hold anything too slippery.

lines.zh: 是块沉船的木片，还有漆。
lines.en: A splinter of wreck wood, still bearing paint.

lines.zh: 我把它放在经常停留的石头上。
lines.en: I set it on the stone where I often rest.

lines.zh: 太重了，我松开，让它沉回去。
lines.en: Too heavy; I let go and it sinks back.

lines.zh: 这个亮片，我会一直带着。
lines.en: This bright flake, I will keep carrying it with me.

lines.zh: 一只小虾在沙上弹，我看到了。
lines.en: A small shrimp springs on the sand; I see it.

lines.zh: 我不常追东西，可这条虫子很近。
lines.en: I rarely chase, but this worm is very near.

lines.zh: 它动了，我的触手先伸出去。
lines.en: It moves, and my arm reaches out first.

lines.zh: 目标就在触手够得到的地方。
lines.en: The target is just within my arms' reach.

lines.zh: 我慢慢压低身子，贴到沙面。
lines.en: I sink my body slowly down against the sand.

lines.zh: 它钻进沙里，只露出一个头。
lines.en: It burrows into the sand, showing only its head.

lines.zh: 我判断错了一次，它跑掉了。
lines.en: I misjudged once and it got away.

lines.zh: 这条小鱼绕着我转，胆子不小。
lines.en: This little fish circles me; it is bold.

lines.zh: 我把触手围成一个圈。
lines.en: I close my arms into a ring around it.

lines.zh: 海床上能吃的，都不算快。
lines.en: What the seabed offers to eat is never fast.

lines.zh: 它往石缝里钻，我堵住另一头。
lines.en: It dives into a crevice; I block the other end.

lines.zh: 我把触手伸进去，慢慢探。
lines.en: I push an arm inside and feel about slowly.

lines.zh: 它撞在我的吸盘上，退不回去了。
lines.en: It hits my suckers and can no longer back out.

lines.zh: 水流告诉我它在哪个方向。
lines.en: The current tells me which way it went.

lines.zh: 我收紧圈子，一条缝也不留。
lines.en: I tighten the ring and leave no gap.

lines.zh: 它不动了，以为我看不见。
lines.en: It freezes, thinking I cannot see it.

lines.zh: 我在等它自己游出来。
lines.en: I am waiting for it to swim out on its own.

lines.zh: 触手尖已经碰到它的尾巴。
lines.en: An arm tip has already touched its tail.

lines.zh: 它一冲，我的圈子跟着合上。
lines.en: It darts, and my ring closes after it.

lines.zh: 这次它跑不掉，我很有耐心。
lines.en: This time it will not escape; I am patient.

lines.zh: 我用触手把它裹住，慢慢收紧。
lines.en: I wrap it in my arms and close them slowly.

lines.zh: 我不咬，我没有能咬的牙。
lines.en: I do not bite; I have no teeth for biting.

lines.zh: 吸盘贴住它，它就动不了了。
lines.en: My suckers take hold, and it cannot move.

lines.zh: 这一下没什么力气，可它很小。
lines.en: There is little force in it, but the prey is small.

lines.zh: 我把它送到嘴边，整个吞下。
lines.en: I bring it to my mouth and swallow it whole.

lines.zh: 它挣了两下，我的触手松了一点。
lines.en: It struggles twice and my arms loosen a little.

lines.zh: 我打不过大的，只挑小的。
lines.en: I cannot fight the big ones; I pick small ones.

lines.zh: 触手一弹，把它推到石壁上。
lines.en: One arm flicks it against the rock wall.

lines.zh: 完事我把触手在沙上擦了擦。
lines.en: Afterwards I wipe my arms on the sand.

lines.zh: 这样的一餐，够我安静两天。
lines.en: A meal like this keeps me quiet for two days.

lines.zh: 我在深海的一片沙坡上出现。
lines.en: I appear on a sandy slope in the deep sea.

lines.zh: 周围很黑，只有水在轻轻动。
lines.en: It is dark around me; only the water stirs.

lines.zh: 我的耳鳍刚张开，还很软。
lines.en: My ear fins have just opened and are still soft.

lines.zh: 头顶的水压得我睁不开眼。
lines.en: The weight of water overhead makes me squint.

lines.zh: 这里没有光，我靠触手认识世界。
lines.en: No light here; I learn the world with my arms.

lines.zh: 第一件事是找一处平一点的沙。
lines.en: My first task is to find flatter sand.

lines.zh: 我浮起来，离海床有一人高。
lines.en: I rise to a person's height above the seabed.

lines.zh: 附近有热泉，水是温的。
lines.en: There is a vent nearby; the water is warm.

lines.zh: 我慢慢往深处游，那里更安静。
lines.en: I drift deeper, where it is quieter.

lines.zh: 从今天起，这片黑海床归我逛。
lines.en: From today, this dark seabed is mine to wander.

lines.zh: 热水烫过耳鳍，边缘卷了起来。
lines.en: Hot water scalds my ear fin and its edge curls.

lines.zh: 我从水层摔到海床，身子拍扁了。
lines.en: I drop through the water and flatten on the seabed.

lines.zh: 我离开水太久，皮肤开始发干。
lines.en: Out of water too long, my skin has started to dry.

lines.zh: 冲击波在深水里闷响，我被掀翻。
lines.en: The blast thuds through deep water and flips me over.

lines.zh: 一支鱼叉擦过我的触手，留下一道痕。
lines.en: A harpoon grazes my arm and leaves a line.

lines.zh: 符文的蓝光罩住我，触手僵住了。
lines.en: Rune light seals around me and my arms go stiff.

lines.zh: 很久没吃到东西，我游得没力气。
lines.en: Nothing eaten for long; I swim without strength.

lines.zh: 雷打进海里，白光穿过整片水层。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the sea and white light fills the water.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水，我的耳鳍乱扇。
lines.en: There is no water in the void; my ear fins flail.
